title: ReferenceMaterialCertificate
description: W3C VC 2.0 credential encoding a Reference Material Certificate per ISO 17034:2016, ISO Guide 31:2015, and DRMD XSD v0.3.0. Issued by an ISO 17034-accredited Reference Material Producer (RMP) to a lot DID.

@context.description: JSON-LD context array. First item MUST be 'https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2'. Second item SHOULD be the QI-VC reference material context.

type.description: Credential type array. MUST contain 'VerifiableCredential' and 'ReferenceMaterialCertificate'.

id.description: Optional globally unique URI for this credential.

issuer.description: DID of the Reference Material Producer (RMP) issuing this certificate. ISO 17034:2016 §4.1.

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 datetime from which this credential is valid. Set to the certification date when property values were formally assigned.

validUntil.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which this credential is no longer valid. Set to the expiry of the certified property values. ISO Guide 31:2015 §10 (period of validity). Required for reference material certificates.

credentialStatus.description: Revocation or suspension status. An RMP may revoke a certificate if post-certification homogeneity or stability issues are identified.

credentialSchema.description: Reference to this schema for validation purposes.

credentialSubject.description: The RMC domain payload. Contains all certified property data per DRMD XSD v0.3.0 and ISO Guide 31:2015.

evidence.description: Evidence that the issuing RMP was authorized to issue this credential. MUST contain a reference to the CapabilityCredential with a cryptographic hashBinding. W3C VC 2.0 §4.9.

proof.description: eddsa-rdfc-2022 Data Integrity proof over the credential.

RmcCredentialSubject.title: RmcCredentialSubject
RmcCredentialSubject.description: The subject of a ReferenceMaterialCertificate. The subject is the specific lot of reference material. Maps to DRMD XSD v0.3.0.

id.description: DID of the reference material lot, e.g. did:example:lot-rm-001. The lot is the subject because certified values are properties of a specific production batch.

materials.description: Descriptions of the reference material(s). Maps to DRMD materials. ISO Guide 31:2015 §5 (description of the material).

materialPropertiesList.description: Certified property values with uncertainties. Maps to DRMD materialPropertiesList. ISO Guide 31:2015 §6 (certified values and uncertainties).

RmcAdministrativeData.title: RmcAdministrativeData
RmcAdministrativeData.description: Administrative metadata for the reference material certificate. Maps to DRMD administrativeData.

coreData.title: RmcCoreData
coreData.description: Core document identification. Maps to DRMD coreData.

titleOfTheDocument.description: Title identifying the type of certificate, e.g. 'Certificate of Analysis', 'Certified Reference Material Certificate'. Maps to DRMD coreData.titleOfTheDocument. ISO Guide 31:2015 §4.1.

uniqueIdentifier.description: Unique certificate identifier. Maps to DRMD coreData.uniqueIdentifier. ISO Guide 31:2015 §4.

validity.title: RmcValidity
validity.description: Validity period of the certified property values as declared by the RMP. Maps to DRMD validity. ISO Guide 31:2015 §10. Distinct from VC validFrom/validUntil which govern cryptographic validity.

validFrom.description: Start date of certified value validity. ISO 8601 date.

validUntil.description: Expiry date of certified value validity. ISO 8601 date. ISO Guide 31:2015 §10.

referenceMaterialProducer.title: ReferenceMaterialProducer
referenceMaterialProducer.description: The Reference Material Producer. Maps to DRMD referenceMaterialProducer. ISO 17034:2016 §4.1.

accreditationNumber.description: ISO 17034:2016 accreditation reference number of the RMP.

Material.title: Material
Material.description: Description of a reference material. Maps to DRMD materials entry. ISO Guide 31:2015 §5.

name.description: Name of the reference material, e.g. 'pH Buffer Solution 7.00'. Maps to DRMD materials.name.

lotNumber.description: Production lot or batch number. Maps to DRMD materials.lotNumber. ISO Guide 31:2015 §5.1.

description.description: Detailed description of the material composition. Maps to DRMD materials.description. ISO Guide 31:2015 §5.2.

materialIdentifiers.description: Typed identifiers for this material. Maps to DRMD materialIdentifiers. Supports multiple schemes (CAS, IUPAC, InChI, lot number, etc.). ISO Guide 31:2015 §5.1.

MaterialIdentifier.title: MaterialIdentifier
MaterialIdentifier.description: A typed identifier for a reference material. Maps to DRMD materialIdentifiers entry.

value.description: The identifier value, e.g. '7732-18-5' for CAS of water.

MaterialPropertyGroup.title: MaterialPropertyGroup
MaterialPropertyGroup.description: Certified values for one or more related properties of the reference material. Maps to DRMD materialPropertiesList entry. ISO Guide 31:2015 §6.

propertyIdentifiers.description: Names or identifiers for the property being certified. Maps to DRMD propertyIdentifiers. Used by the verifier to check Rule 6 (scope check) against the CapabilityCredential. Multiple identifiers allow matching across naming conventions.

results.description: Certified values for this property. Maps to DRMD results. ISO Guide 31:2015 §6.1 (certified values and uncertainties).

RmcMeasurementReading.title: RmcMeasurementReading
RmcMeasurementReading.description: A single certified property value. Nested as results[].data.quantity to match DRMD XSD nesting and allow future qualitative or count-type property values.

quantity.description: The certified property value: quantityKind, value, unit, uncertainty. Maps to DRMD results.data.quantity.

RmcStatements.title: RmcStatements
RmcStatements.description: Mandatory statements required by ISO Guide 31:2015. Maps to DRMD statements.

intendedUse.description: Intended use of the reference material. ISO Guide 31:2015 §7. Maps to DRMD statements.intendedUse.

storageConditions.description: Storage conditions to maintain certified property values. ISO Guide 31:2015 §9. Maps to DRMD statements.storageConditions.

handlingInstructions.description: Instructions for use and handling. ISO Guide 31:2015 §7. Maps to DRMD statements.handlingInstructions.

metrologicalTraceability.description: Statement of metrological traceability of the certified values to SI units or other reference standards. ISO Guide 31:2015 §8. ISO 17034:2016 §7.7. Maps to DRMD statements.metrologicalTraceability.
